scope: Offline stock Case fault-policy trace; working iPhone pair unchanged; no device access.

findings.finding: Right no-reply timeout can set state+0x4D and state+0x4F, the same pair set by electrical water detection. These flags do not uniquely identify moisture.

Right inhibit state+0x4D selects YHM register4=0xAE instead of 0xAF. Verified by 64 offline native cases covering presence, gate, both inhibit flags and paired-presence policy. This records requested register values, not measured supply voltage/current.

After the counter exceeds300, secondary flag state+0x4F nonzero causes counter clearing without glasses_charge_state_reset. With secondary flag zero, ordinary standby can call reset. Actual cadence not independently timed.
Hall-event path resets ordinary right standby only with inhibit nonzero, counter nonzero, secondary fault flag zero. Opening lid is not demonstrated to clear the fault-marked condition.
Charge-state reset clears inhibit+0x4D, several counters and status bytes; does not directly clear secondary+0x4F. Full removal and initialization clear lifecycle remains unresolved.

recovery_implication: Silence may precede and cause Case supply inhibition; LED does not distinguish interrupted firmware from battery/hardware failure. No verified new ROM/SBL entry path or safe reason to override inhibit was found.
next_evidence: Trace exact removal/initialization stores and read-only stock diagnostic visibility of flags before proposing any live capture. Do not bypass electrical protection.
validation: work/case-fault-policy/verify.py; work/case-fault-policy/evidence.json; 64 native offline cases pass. Helper080099E8 mocked. No hardware validation.
